title: Pages
subtitle: Small tools the assistant made for you. They open here, in a sandbox, and keep their data in your files.
error: The pages could not be read: {{message}}

card.ask: Ask the assistant to change this
card.deleteMessage: The folder {{folder}} goes to the Trash. You can restore it from Files.

empty.title: No pages yet
empty.text: A page is a small tool, like a task board or a reading list. Ask the assistant for one in a chat, or start from a ready page.
empty.note: This entry leaves the sidebar when you have no pages. It comes back with your next one.

view.runsAsYouHint: The page reads and writes the files of its folder with your rights. It cannot reach the network or your other files.

view.makeStart: Make this my first pinned page

send.label: This page wants to send a message to the assistant

shared.note: A shared page runs only after you allow it. If its author changes it, you are asked again.

viewer.sandboxShared: Sandboxed. Runs as you, in {{folder}} only, and cannot reach the network.

trust.title: Open "{{title}}"?

items.files: Read and write files in its own folder

items.chat: Write a message into a chat

items.noFiles: Read your other files or chats

items.noTools: Use tools or change your settings

trust.warn: It acts as you inside its folder. If {{author}} changes it, you are asked again.

changed.title: "{{title}}" has changed
changed.desc: You allowed an earlier version. Check what changed before it runs again.
changed.same: What it can do is the same as before.
changed.warn: If you allow it, this version runs each time you open it, until {{author}} changes it again.
changed.code: A script, style sheet or module of the page changed: {{files}}

frame.chrome: Shared page from {{folder}}. It has not run.

blocked.title: This page has not run
blocked.body: You chose not to run it. It comes from {{author}}'s shared folder {{folder}}. Nothing in it has run, and nothing was saved.

waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.body: Nothing in this page runs until you allow it.

stopped.revoked: You stopped allowing this page. It stopped running and nothing else in it runs until you allow it again.
stopped.refused: This page is no longer allowed, so it was stopped. Review it to allow it again.
stopped.off: Shared pages were turned off on this server, so this page was stopped.

trust.changedMeanwhile: The page changed while you were reviewing it. This is the new version.
trust.sourceNote: The source is shown as text. Nothing in it runs here.

embed.desc: You allowed this page to open. On Home, in a slot and in the dock it runs as soon as the screen shows, without a click, so it needs its own yes.
embed.item: Run on Home, in the slots of the app and in the dock
embed.note: It starts when the screen shows, without a click. A change by its author asks again.
embed.allow: Allow on Home, in slots and in the dock

frame.filesFailed: Files next to this page did not load: {{files}}. The browser console says why.
frame.tooLarge: This page puts more than {{limit}} of files from its folder into itself, so some were left out. Load data with fetch() instead.
